# Requirements Quality Checklist: Checkout Page

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurable quality of the checkout requirements.
**Created**: 2026-10-14
**Feature**: [../spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all monetary components of the displayed total explicitly included or excluded, including shipping, taxes, discounts, and rounding? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–002, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK002 Are quantity bounds, zero quantity behavior, and maximum purchasable quantities defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all submission outcomes specified, including validation failure, service failure, price change, unavailable product, duplicate request, and confirmation retrieval failure? [Coverage, Spec §Story 2, §Edge Cases, §FR-007–010]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for preserving/recovering customer-entered details across refresh, session expiry, or retry? [Gap, Spec §FR-008, §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the accepted Indian mobile-number format and normalization rule unambiguous and consistent with mobile OTP requirements? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK006 Are maximum lengths, accepted characters, normalization, and validation rules specified for name and delivery address? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the confirmation requirement specific about what order identifier, status, and next-step information the shopper receives? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the required explicit-review step after a server-side price/availability change distinguished from ordinary checkout refresh? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Are the use of current item prices, displayed line totals, server-submitted totals, and changed-price review consistent across the spec? [Consistency, Spec §Story 1, §Story 3, §FR-001–002, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the India-only mobile requirement and guest checkout assumption consistent with the separate OTP authentication flow? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Are successful cart clearing, duplicate prevention, and confirmation-recovery requirements consistent when persistence succeeds but the response is lost? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-007–008]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK012 Can total correctness be measured for currency precision, line-level rounding, and all supported quantities? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the usability thresholds and completion time defined with participant/sample, viewport, and start/end conditions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–002, §SC-006]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Are concurrent cart edits and cart changes from another tab/device addressed so the submitted order matches the reviewed summary? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are retries after uncertain commit outcomes specified so the shopper can recover without losing the cart or creating a duplicate order? [Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK016 Are invalid customer details, empty cart, unavailable products, and changed prices all assigned clear field/item-specific recovery actions? [Coverage, Spec §Story 2, §Story 3, §FR-004–005, §FR-010–011]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK017 Are accessible announcements defined for updated totals, field errors, changed prices, submission progress, and order confirmation? [Coverage, Spec §Accessibility Requirements]
- [ ] CHK018 Are privacy, retention, and exposure limits specified for the submitted mobile number and delivery address? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, §Key Entities]

## Dependencies, Assumptions, and Ambiguities

- [ ] CHK019 Are Cart, Catalog, and Order ownership and the source of truth for price, availability, cart contents, and order totals explicitly documented? [Dependency, Spec §FR-001–002, §FR-010, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 Are the absence of payment processing and any taxes, shipping charges, or discounts confirmed as intentional scope boundaries? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
